title: Stress echocardiogram
what: The doctor does a heart ultrasound at rest and right after exercise: on a treadmill, a bike, or with medicine. It shows if your heart gets enough blood when it works hard.
why: For chest pain, to check the heart's arteries; after treatment of the heart arteries; or to check the valves under stress.
duration: usually 45 to 60 minutes; the report is usually ready the same day
tell_doctor: All heart and blood pressure medicines. Your doctor will say if any should be skipped
Chest pain, shortness of breath, or fainting
Joint problems that make walking or pedaling hard
Asthma. This matters if the stress will be done with medicine

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: A light meal 2 to 3 hours before the test. Do not come hungry or very full.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Some heart medicines are sometimes paused for a short time. Do not stop them on your own. Your doctor decides.

prepare.title: Coffee and smoking
prepare.text: On the test day, usually no coffee, strong tea, or smoking. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: Sportswear and comfortable shoes for walking.

steps: ECG stickers are put on your chest and a blood pressure cuff on your arm
The doctor does a heart ultrasound at rest
You walk on a treadmill or pedal a bike, and the load slowly goes up
Sometimes medicine is given into a vein instead of exercise
Right after exercise, you lie down and the doctor quickly repeats the ultrasound
Then you rest until your pulse and blood pressure return to normal
feel: You will get tired, and your pulse and breathing will speed up. This is expected
Speak up right away if you have chest pain, strong shortness of breath, or dizziness. The test will be stopped
after: After resting, you can go back to your usual day
The report is usually ready the same day
Go over the results with a cardiologist
red_flags: Chest pain that does not go away after the test: tell the doctor right away or call emergency services
Fainting, strong shortness of breath, or skipped heartbeats

faq.q: Is it dangerous for the heart?
faq.a: The test is done under a doctor's watch, with everything for help nearby. It is stopped at the first warning signs.

faq.q: What if I cannot walk for long?
faq.a: Say so in advance. The stress can be done with medicine, without walking.

reminders.text: Stress echo tomorrow. Bring sports shoes and a list of your medicines. Skip coffee in the morning. Check with the clinic.
